passages.provision_quote: None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available under any Act appropriating funds for the Department of Defense or the Department of State for fiscal year 2024 or any prior years may be made available-- (1) to withhold, halt, reverse, or cancel the delivery of defense articles or defense services from the United States to Israel
passages.note: Cosponsored a single-subject bill barring any withholding of deliveries to Israel: shows continued aid, but the operative text never states 'no new conditions' (the 'without any additional conditions' line is a finding, not operative), so rung 1's absence clause is unmet.
Yea on final passage of H.R. 8369 (224-187, not near-unanimous); same reading as the bill text: pro-aid side, rungs 1 and 2 not separated.
passages.actor_quote: Houchin Houchin Republican Indiana IN Yea

passages.provision_quote: $3,500,000,000, to remain available until September 30, 2025, for assistance for Israel and for related expenses
passages.note: Israel supplemental that also funds general humanitarian aid, FEMA nonprofit grants and other accounts; per the annex a supplemental shows continued aid at most and cannot separate rungs 1 and 2.
Yea on passage of H.R. 8034 (366-58); direction at most.
passages.actor_quote: Houchin Houchin Republican Indiana IN Yea

rows.reasoning: Houchin cosponsored and voted Yea on H.R. 8369, which bars using funds 'to withhold, halt, reverse, or cancel the delivery of defense articles' to Israel, and voted Yea on the H.R. 8034 Israel supplemental; both show she would continue aid. Neither instrument states that aid carries 'no new conditions', and no vote against a conditioning amendment or own words rejecting conditions is in the sources, so 'Continue full military aid to Israel with no new conditions' cannot be separated from 'Continue aid to Israel, but require it to comply with humanitarian and human-rights law'.
